subject.title: fix(agents): classify Anthropic invalid_request_error as format for failover

question: Should structured provider `invalid_request_error` payloads be treated as fallback-worthy `format` errors by default, including user/config-caused request validation errors?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but the behavior changes provider/model routing for configured fallback chains and needs maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept after guard and proof
options.body: Merge a guarded implementation once formatter behavior is preserved and redacted runtime proof shows fallback advancing.

options.title: Narrow the classifier
options.body: Limit fallback eligibility to known provider-generated schema/replay cases if maintainers do not want all structured invalid-request payloads to switch models.

options.title: Use the sibling PR as canonical
options.body: Resolve the conflicts in the broader sibling PR and close this branch once that PR is clean and ready again.

recommendation.title: Accept after guard and proof
recommendation.body: Merge a guarded implementation once formatter behavior is preserved and redacted runtime proof shows fallback advancing.
